correctness.rationale: The polynomial is squarefree and genus is exactly 3^s; the explicit characteristic-three Cartier–Manin matrix has at most one nonzero per row/column. Its ternary partial shift permits an all-s, all-j exact path count including j=2s and the nilpotence boundary. Over F3 semilinear twists preserve coefficients. The stable rank and a-number follow by standard definitions; Katsura Theorem 4.1 applies because the polynomial has his normalized cubic components, degree 6n−4, and only simple critical points. Six exact finite computations corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The coefficient map has a structured two-pass ternary dynamics yielding an exact full nilpotence filtration for a smooth hyperelliptic family in arbitrarily high genus. This gives concrete zero-3-rank Jacobians with exact a-numbers, and through Katsura a uniform infinite collection of quasi-elliptic surfaces whose entire Mordell–Weil group vanishes. These are natural invariants and a substantive higher-iterate computation, not just a isolated numerical check, normalization or theorem restatement.
